label: Printful fulfillments
description: Durable job that carries one paid Swell order through Printful create, cost calculation and confirmation. One row per order. order_id is unique, which is a read-then-write check rather than a database index — it collapses ordinary duplicate deliveries but leaves a residual race under true concurrency.

order_id.description: Swell order being fulfilled. Unique — a duplicate order.paid delivery loses the insert and exits. The server enforces this by reading for a match before inserting, so two inserts racing inside that window can both succeed; the durable guard against submitting the same order to Printful twice would be Printful enforcing external_id uniqueness, which is unverified

external_id.description: Swell order id sent to Printful as external_id, so a created order can be re-read at /v2/orders/@{external_id} instead of being created again

state.description: pending: claimed, nothing sent. created: draft exists at Printful. calculating: waiting on Printful costs. confirmed: submitted for production — this is the charge point. failed: needs an operator

printful_order_id.description: Set once the Printful draft exists or has been adopted

attempts.description: Transport failures so far. The advance function backs off exponentially and gives up at 8

date_next_attempt.description: When to advance this job next. The advance function schedules off this field, so writing it re-arms the job

last_error.description: Most recent Printful or transport error

types.description: A paid order was claimed for fulfillment
The job advanced or was rescheduled
The job gave up or Printful rejected the order
